column1: # Unchecked-arithmetic manifest — the reviewed registry behind scripts/check-unchecked.sh.
# One row per `unchecked { ... }` block in the game facade, its storage base and the modules
# (scripts/lib/unchecked_extract.py). The rationale records the invariant that keeps every op
# in range; the gate keeps the registry in exact correspondence with source.
# Classes: BOUNDED (a guard / cap / width argument, named) · NO-OVERFLOW-OP (nothing in the block
# can leave the range) · WRAP-INTENDED (modular arithmetic on purpose) · SCALE-BOUNDED (no code
# guard for normal owed and pass lanes: economic scale only. Far-future owed saturates at
# 2^30-1 through _saturateFarFutureOwed; each mixed-domain row records both cases).
# Columns: CLASS  file  function  ordinal  head  rationale
